title: Billing Dispute and Service Recovery
purpose: Show the agent handling a billing dispute first, then assessing an appropriate follow-up option after resolution.

steps.label: Start billing call
steps.description: Bind the customer, call, and agent identity to the current session.

steps.label: Customer explains the billing issue
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Hello, I’m calling about an unexpected monthly charge on my latest statement.
steps.description: The customer explains the billing issue; the platform begins deriving the fee theme from the transcript.

steps.label: Agent acknowledges and starts the review
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I can review the statement with you. I’ll check the charge details first and make sure we address your question before anything else.
steps.description: The agent confirms the order of operations: review the statement before making any recommendation.

steps.label: Customer adds amount and timing
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: The statement shows a charge from this month, but I don’t remember approving it or seeing it explained.
steps.description: The customer adds billing details and the fee theme continues.

steps.label: Agent restates the billing request
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: You’re asking us to identify the charge, explain why it appeared, and correct it if it was not expected. I’ll do that now.
steps.description: The agent restates the customer request as the service objective: identify, explain, and correct.

steps.label: Customer expresses fee dissatisfaction
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: This feels unfair and expensive, and I need someone to resolve it rather than send me another offer.
steps.description: The customer clearly expresses dissatisfaction; fee sentiment becomes negative and the complaint signal becomes active.

steps.label: Agent commits to handling the billing issue first
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I understand. I’ll keep this call focused on the billing issue and explain the result clearly before we consider anything else.
steps.description: The agent acknowledges the emotion and sets the service scope.

steps.label: Customer asks to complete the review first
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: That’s what I need. Please tell me what caused the charge and whether it can be credited back.
steps.description: The customer sets the priority and provides dialogue evidence for commercial suppression.

steps.label: Suppress commercial assistance
steps.description: Even if the model finds the customer relevant, the unresolved billing issue blocks an additional commercial recommendation.

steps.label: Agent confirms there will be no interruptive offer
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: Understood. I’ll resolve the charge first, and I won’t add a new product conversation while the billing issue is open.
steps.description: The agent follows the live assistance and avoids commercial interruption while the complaint is open.

steps.label: Customer accepts the resolution plan
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: If you can credit the charge and explain the account clearly, that will solve it for me.
steps.description: The customer confirms acceptable resolution conditions.

steps.label: Agent proposes a billing correction
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I found the charge and can issue the credit today. I’ll also leave a clear note explaining what happened.
steps.description: The agent gives a concrete correction action and waits for customer confirmation before changing complaint authority.

steps.label: Customer confirms the billing issue is resolved
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Thank you. That answers my question, and I’m comfortable with the credit and explanation.
steps.description: The customer confirms the service result; the business workflow can now record resolution.

steps.label: Complete issue resolution
steps.description: An authorized business event confirms that the billing issue has been handled.

steps.label: Agent confirms the billing status
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: The billing issue is now resolved. If you have another question about saving regularly, I can explain the available options.
steps.description: After authoritative resolution, the agent naturally opens space for a follow-up question.

steps.label: Customer asks a savings question
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Now that this is sorted out, could you show me an easier way to save a small amount each month?
steps.description: The customer raises a follow-up need after resolution; the platform can reassess commercial assistance.

steps.label: Generate follow-up assistance
steps.description: Assistance appears only after eligibility, product facts, guidance, and explanation checks pass.

steps.label: Deliver assistance to the agent desktop
steps.description: Record server publication.

steps.label: Agent desktop acknowledges the display
steps.description: Record that the browser applied the complete assistance snapshot.

steps.label: End the call
steps.description: End the live session and withdraw active assistance.

steps.label: Generate the service summary
steps.description: Write the final transcript snapshot to the post-call interaction record.

steps.label: Verify retry safety
steps.description: Run the same post-call job again without creating a duplicate interaction record.
